segments: Every IC congregation all over the world
is keeping the feast of tabernacles
right now. We're going through the act
of tabernacles together, which is a
sacrifice of all the creature comforts
that we're used to. Now, guess what?
There's a lot of folks that live in
different countries, the 12 tribes, that
they live in a style of tabernacles all
day long. They might only get one meal a
day. A lot of times, electricity is not
even on for half the day in the country.
So, especially us in Babylon, it teaches
us we have to go through a common
struggle together, which is going to
help us prepare for the times to come
cuz times are not going to get any
easier. We're being a light to the
world. This is a dark place and the Lord
is allowing our light to shine among all
of those that are inquiring. What are
you guys up to? This is a large group.
This is a large I've never seen so many

we're elated to be able to share the
truth with them as well because they
don't realize they should be keeping the
commandments. But it's a blessing to be
able to not only have tabernacles in the
east, central, and west coast, but to
rejoice at all the photos, the phone
calls, the messages of everyone
in IUIC across the world keeping the
feast of tabernacles.
